steps.label: score-fixture
steps.sql: CREATE TABLE ScoreDocs (id bigint NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, body text, bodytokens spanner.tokenlist GENERATED ALWAYS AS (spanner.tokenize_fulltext(body)) VIRTUAL HIDDEN)

steps.label: score-search-index
steps.sql: CREATE SEARCH INDEX ScoreIndex ON ScoreDocs(BodyTokens)

steps.label: score-insert
statements: INSERT INTO ScoreDocs(Id,Body) VALUES (1,'cat cat dog'),(2,'cat dog'),(3,'dog')

steps.label: score-pagination-insert
statements: INSERT INTO ScoreDocs(Id,Body) VALUES (4,'cat cat cat banana'),(5,'cat banana'),(6,'cat dog dog dog'),(7,'cat')

steps.label: pagination-v1-full
steps.sql: SELECT Id, spanner.score(BodyTokens,$1, options=>$2) AS score FROM ScoreDocs WHERE spanner.search(BodyTokens,$1) ORDER BY score DESC,Id

steps.label: pagination-v1-offset-0
steps.sql: SELECT Id, spanner.score(BodyTokens,$1, options=>$2) AS score FROM ScoreDocs WHERE spanner.search(BodyTokens,$1) ORDER BY score DESC,Id LIMIT $3 OFFSET $4

steps.label: pagination-v1-offset-2
steps.sql: SELECT Id, spanner.score(BodyTokens,$1, options=>$2) AS score FROM ScoreDocs WHERE spanner.search(BodyTokens,$1) ORDER BY score DESC,Id LIMIT $3 OFFSET $4
